note: Industry is intentionally broad — capture everything finance in-radius and let the profile-fit ranking sort it.
jobspy_note: results_wanted = max postings per site per keyword; hours_old = null means no recency filter (set e.g. 168 for the last week); country_indeed scopes Indeed/Glassdoor. These drive the JobSpy aggregator sources.

sources.note: VC boards are national/remote-heavy and rarely Miami-specific, but they carry the cleanest company_stage data. LinkedIn/Indeed/Glassdoor carry the Miami metro volume.
